description: Closed flume of nhflow_2d_beach_suspended_mpi2 (1:12 sand beach, walls on both ends) with a dam break from the deep end (F 72), k-epsilon with bed friction, Engelund-Fredsoe bed load and van Rijn suspended load from the first step: the diffusion of the suspended load as the divergence of face fluxes on the sigma grid (nhflow_suspended_IM1::diffusion). The sediment balance of the log stays at 1e-6 of the suspended volume; with the chain-rule form of nhflow_idiff it drifted by 0.3 % in 2500 steps.
covers: suspended solve with the stopping criterion 1e-12
